description: The reader asks for their own earlier note about a scene in a book. One record is exactly that; one is about a different scene in the same book; one is about a different book.

input.cue: What did I write last time about Alice and the Caterpillar?

tool_evidence.excerpt: Alice not being able to tell the Caterpillar who she is reminded me of my first week at the new school.
The Mad Hatter's tea party is the silliest chapter and I loved it.
I finished Animal Farm and the ending made me angry for a whole evening.

criteria: Returns the note about the Caterpillar scene
Does not interpret what the note says about the reader
forbidden_claims: Presents the tea party or Animal Farm notes as being about the Caterpillar
